incoming.name: Marie Curie
incoming.excerpt: Element 96 Curium (Cm) was named in honour of her and Pierre.

outgoing.name: Marie Curie
outgoing.excerpt: The team named the new element after Marie Curie and her husband Pierre who are famous for discovering radium and for their work in radioactivity.

outgoing.name: University of Chicago
outgoing.excerpt: It was chemically identified at the Metallurgical Laboratory (now Argonne National Laboratory) at the University of Chicago.
